chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام used to walk while the litters and baggage were driven along with him.

key_terms.الرِّحَالُ: baggage, travel gear, or saddled equipment
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ: Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, the person described in the report
key_terms.الْمَحَامِلُ: litters or riding carriages carried on animals

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام travel during hajj?
ai.summary: This report describes Imam al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام traveling on foot while his riding litters and baggage accompanied him. It reflects a biographical detail connected to hajj and conveys humility and devotion in worship.
